:::{#def-predictive-model}
#### Predictive model

A **predictive model** is a [model family](#def-model-family) or [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) whose purpose is to [predict](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) the outcomes of [new observations](#def-new-observation).
Its quality is judged by its [prediction error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-error) on new observations,
not by whether its form describes how the outcome arises.

:::
